unit.unitinstructions:
Welcome to the Delphic Maxims

The Delphic Maxims are a set of 147 aphorisms inscribed at Delphi in ancient Greece. Attributed to the Seven Sages of Greece and Apollo, these maxims embody the ancient Greek values and philosophy.

How this works

You will be shown a number (1-147), and you need to type the corresponding maxim text. The adaptive learning system will help you memorize all 147 maxims by spacing them out based on your performance.

Tips for success

  • Type the complete maxim text (e.g., "Follow the gods", "Know thyself")
  • The system tracks your progress and brings back maxims you struggle with more frequently
  • Correct answers earn points and move the maxim to longer-term memory
  • Take your time to learn the wisdom of the ancient Greeks!
